passage: Public transportation systems are becoming increasingly important in modern cities. As populations grow, traffic congestion and pollution continue to rise. Buses, trains, and subways provide efficient alternatives to private vehicles, reducing the number of cars on the road. Many governments have invested heavily in transportation infrastructure to encourage more citizens to use public transit. Although some people prefer the convenience of personal cars, public transportation often saves money, reduces environmental damage, and improves overall urban mobility.
